# Third-party release materials

This directory preserves the license and source-access materials needed to reproduce and redistribute KParser - Sanctum Edition releases. These files do not change the license of KParser itself.

- `ZedGraph-5.1.5` contains the LGPL 2.1 license and the official SourceForge source archive corresponding to the bundled 5.1.5 assembly.
- `Microsoft-SQL-Server-Compact-4.0` contains the EULA and redistribution notice installed with SQL Server Compact 4.0 SP1.
- `Microsoft-VC90-CRT` contains the notice installed with the x86 private runtime shipped as part of SQL Server Compact private deployment.
- `Microsoft-dotnet` contains the license and third-party notices from the .NET installation used for the self-contained dashboard build.

Recheck these materials whenever a dependency or build SDK changes.
